bull.last: LMT: argues long. bear.last: LMT: Going long on LMT right ahead of the 2026-10-22 BMO earnings is a crowded, late-stage trap after a sharp +8.43% 5-day run that pushes RSI to 61.2 and prices in perfection. The stock is still trapped below its declining 200-day SMA of 559.76, and with short-sale volume surging to 61.8% despite a low float short interest, underlying institutional skepticism is palpable. Furthermore, insiders have unloaded 9 times totaling $117,623 with zero open market buys in the last 90 days, signaling management believes current levels are fully valued. Buying the breakout here ignores heavy overhead resistance and leaves longs completely exposed to a classic 'sell-the-news' reaction.
